recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高、脂肪空泡稀少，其中大量中型細胞核呈卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，成片分佈，夾雜少數深染圓核的紅血球系前驅細胞與一顆巨核細胞；這些未成熟細胞增多的區域，符合移植後急性骨髓性白血病（AML）復發。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with only a few small fat spaces
Sheets of medium-sized immature cells with oval to irregular or folded nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Scattered erythroid precursors with small round dark nuclei, and eosinophilic granulocytes
A single megakaryocyte with abundant pink cytoplasm and a mildly lobulated nucleus
Occasional mitotic figures; focal hemosiderin pigment
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with scant residual fat. There are sheets of medium-sized immature mononuclear cells with oval to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with scattered erythroid precursors, eosinophilic granulocytes, occasional mitoses and a single megakaryocyte. Blast percentage cannot be precisely quantified on H&E alone. In the setting of prior stem cell transplant, findings are consistent with recurrent acute myeloid leukemia; CD34/CD117 immunohistochemistry, aspirate differential and chimerism studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows clusters of left-shifted but maturing myeloid and erythroid islands without sheets of CD34+ blasts.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in accelerated or blast phase
ddx.vs: CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1, which requires cytogenetic/molecular confirmation.
Donor-cell leukemia is morphologically identical and is distinguished by chimerism analysis showing donor origin.
